note: PADDING and START, the two `string-pad' arguments u0-subr-x-string-helpers does not reach, plus the case that decides whether the name is a padder or a formatter. Emacs answers ("axx" "  a" "abcd" "  "): PADDING replaces the space, a non-nil START pads on the LEFT, and a string ALREADY longer than LENGTH comes back untouched -- it never truncates. Recorded because U.1a's implementation relies on all three and the frozen row only pins the default.
